messages.subject: Boston useR Meetup on Stan (1 August 2016)
parts:
http://www.meetup.com/Boston-useR/events/232259941/

For our August meeting, Ben Goodrich (Columbia U. and Stan developer,
see http://www.columbia.edu/~bg2382/ ) will give us an introduction
and overview of Stan and how to use it from R.

Dan Flynn (Harvard's Department of Organismic and Evolutionary Biology,
see http://oeb.harvard.edu/people/daniel-flynn) will give a short
introduction to using it to address questions of how plants respond to
climate change.

I aslo added it to our list of upcoming events:

http://mc-stan.org/events

Let us know if there are others you know about. I keep
reading about Bayesian/Stan/PyMC meetups in London after
they happen on R bloggers.

- Bob
